title: Logical Torches
description: This mod makes torches in vanilla Minecraft logical
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b918db057c5da12b3d53ae956a8889bd645a43ef.png)

Improved Off-hand Logic
Torches held in the off-hand (shield slot) can no longer be placed by right-clicking. This prevents accidental torch placement while you are placing blocks or fighting.

Dynamic Lighting Mechanics 
Ignite from Blocks: Right-click a Stick on any active heat source to turn it into a Torch. Supported blocks include:
Torches & Wall Torches
Active Furnaces, Smokers, and Blast Furnaces
Campfires
Fire block & Soul Fire
Redstone Block

Manual Ignition: Hold a Stick in your main hand and a Flint and Steel or Fire Charge in your off-hand. Right-click to craft a torch instantly with custom sound effects.

Lava Charring: Right-clicking Lava with a stick won't light it—instead, the extreme heat turns it into a Burnt Stick.


Interacting with heat sources isn't "free." To keep the game balanced, the following rules apply:

Fuel Consumption: Right-clicking a Furnace, Smoker, or Blast Furnace 6 times will consume 1 unit of its current fuel.

Source Depletion: Right-clicking a Torch or Redstone Block 6 times will cause the block to break/burn out.

Extinguishing Fires: Using a Campfire as a light source 6 times will extinguish the fire, requiring you to relight it.

New Item: Burnt Stick
Obtained by clicking a stick on Lava.
Can be placed in a crafting grid to produce 1 Charcoal, making it a primitive way to get fuel.
